artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: report written, three records amended, six filed descriptions updated; phase 5 closed with one reasoned exclusion.

completion_data.completion_summary: Wrote docs/development/stability-operator-family.md recommending that the stability operator stay in the Modal family, amended records/proof-mode-architecture.md, records/theorem-library.md and records/proof-mode.md to state that layout as settled (K core plus T, 4, 5; operator set as a lattice coordinate), and replaced the layout hedges in six filed task descriptions.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic operator-family layout: place of the stability operator
sapience_notes.value: The stability operator stays in the Modal family, read as the necessity operators over histories with laws parameterized by operator. A separate Stability family records the same eight cells (fragment times operator set) and two of its four added fragments are degenerate, because without Temporal the operator is the identity on state-local formulas. Grounds are in docs/development/stability-operator-family.md.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic shared necessity statement
sapience_notes.value: The shared Modal statement is stratified: a K core (scope introduction, distribution, monotonicity, diamond duals) with T, 4, 5 as separate members and D for a serial operator. Inclusion (ordered pair of operators), rigidity (operator plus a rigid formula class) and interactions with Temporal are per-operator pieces outside it. The compiled K core is NecessityRules in FormalSystem/Theorems/ProofMode/Congruence/Modal.lean, with instances tmBox, plusBox, plusStability; it has no T, 4 or 5 members yet.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic necessity operators and their strengths
sapience_notes.value: The Open language operators (open-future and open-past) are S5 necessities with K, T, 4, 5 as OpenAxiom constructors and derived necessitation, exactly like stability. The nomic operator is KD in general (nomic_serial), KT on lawful frames, and S5 only on uniform frames or the tense-free fragment; it has no calculus and is evaluated over NomicFrame, not TaskFrame, so it instantiates the laws but not the proof-mode interface. K and necessitation for it over arbitrary nomic frames is an inference from the truth clause, not a named theorem.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic theorem-library tableau pipeline
sapience_notes.value: The pipeline step that generalizes a certified formula from atoms to schema variables is sound only where uniform substitution holds, so the pipeline runs on cells whose operator set is within the box operator alone. TM-plus is not closed under uniform substitution because atom_stab holds for atoms and state-local formulas only. Each restricted necessity has a rigid class: state-local for stability, pure-past and pure-future for the two Open operators.

sapience_notes.subject: cslib hosting of a second necessity operator on one formula type (commit 3bdf16d9f)
sapience_notes.value: cslib modal axiom classes and Modal*Hilbert bundles take [HasBox F] as an instance argument, so they are operator-parameterized in type, but instance resolution cannot find a second box. Routes without upstream change: explicit non-instance HasBox, a type synonym, or a ProofSigHom with Deriv.map. cslib own precedent for G and H is operator-specific axiom classes over HasUntil and HasSince, not a second HasBox.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh in a consumer repository of the agent system
sapience_notes.value: In BimodalLogic, verify-touched.sh exited 1 with nine failing agent-system self-test suites (eight selected, one in the free-cost fallback set) regardless of the task edits, because their fixtures expect the source store at agent-system/extensions/core inside the repository while the real source_dir is under ~/.config/nvim. The run takes about four minutes and the harness auto-backgrounded it at 180 seconds even with the Bash timeout parameter at 600000. verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 4 --skip-unchanged is the scoped check that works for markdown-only work there.
